marina: Starting my swing shift handoff — observed creeping p99 on text-gen in us-west1 since ~2026-03-17T01:20Z. Embeddings ingest latency trending up too. What I did: rolled back batching-policy change, scaled encoder pool +10 pods, and flushed KV cache on genc-12b-04. p99 dropped from ~760ms -> ~420ms but still spiky. Suspect redis/read-replica read latency spike. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/ops/latency?panel=us-west1
ajay: Created incident INC-2026 and attached runbook. Can you paste a snippet of the redis slowlog and the embed queue depth?
marina: Sure — snippet from slowlog around the spike:
```
1524839 161790 0.042 127.0.0.1:6379 [READ] get model:kvcache:emb-12b
1524840 161794 0.058 10.10.44.12:6379 [READ] get model:kvcache:emb-12b
1524841 161795 0.060 10.10.44.13:6379 [READ] get model:kvcache:emb-12b
```
Embed pipeline queue depth at peak ~1.6k -> after scale ~420.
kevin: Noted. Last time we saw similar it was node-level NIC drops + CPU steal on a subset of encoder nodes. Can you paste `kubectl describe node genc-12b-04` or the node events? Also check redis client timeout increases (tcp_retransmits).
sasha: I'm taking the handoff. Plan: spin up 2 additional read-replicas in us-west1 (will keep them warm), add a short-term autoscale rule: read-replicas min 3 -> 6, and enable connection pooling knob for the encoder service. ETA ~25m. I'll also tail /var/log/net-errors on nodes. :thumbsup:
ajay: I'll open a follow-up PR to make the batching-policy rollback the default if we see 2+ recurrences in 24h. Assigned to ajay, will link the PR to INC-2026. Also adding a metric alert: redis_read_p95 > 20ms for 5m -> page.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026 created • https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026 • severity: Sev2 • runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/ops/kvcache-redis-latency • responders: @ajay @sasha @kevin
marina: Handoff notes recorded in the incident: actions taken, slowlog sample, pre/post p99 numbers, nodes scaled. Blockers for handoff: need confirmation on whether NIC errors continue after scale; if yes, escalate to cloud infra (ticket created if persists).
sasha: Acknowledged. I'll post back with the read-replica add logs and pid of the pooling change. Monitoring targets: p99 < 500ms, embed queue depth < 500, redis_read_p95 < 20ms. If any breach, I'll trigger rollback to previous image and open provider ticket.
marina: Thanks — handing off to @sasha. I'll be around for 30m for questions, then OOO. Good luck. :pray:
